name: Balatro Steamodded mod
summary: A Balatro mod for Steamodded: the metadata json, a main Lua file and an example Joker.
description: A folder for %APPDATA%\Balatro\Mods. Steamodded finds a mod by its metadata json, which names the Lua file to run. The example Joker uses the game's own card art, so the mod works before you have drawn anything.

options.label: Mod name
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Author
options.patternHelp: start with a letter; letters, digits, spaces, - and _ only

options.label: Description
options.default: One or two sentences about the mod.
options.help: Shown in the game's Mods menu.

options.label: Prefix
options.patternHelp: 2 to 16 lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter
options.help: Added to the key of everything the mod registers. Must differ from every other mod's prefix, and must never change once people have saves with the mod.

options.label: Oldest Steamodded version
options.help: The mod refuses to load on an older Steamodded. 1.* means any stable release.

options.label: Example Joker
options.help: A Joker that gives Mult, with its text and the steps for your own artwork.

next: Install the Lovely injector and Steamodded first if Balatro does not have them yet.
Start Balatro and open Mods on the main menu: {{ModName}} is in the list.
Your code is in main.lua. Hold M in game to restart it quickly after a change.
